precedence.rule: A later write to the same path supplies final bytes. Current guide/features/request choices below follow actual metadata; no generic host-over-shared fallback exists.
Codex guide/features/request come from the shared decision directory, copied after templates. No host-local decision-guide template is configured. Windows then rewrites guide launcher spelling.

Claude guide is the host-local template rendered in shared_templates. Later copy_files copies only shared request/features, not shared guide. Thus host guide survives because no colliding shared-guide copy is configured, not because host templates always take priority.

Both content hosts directly choose claude-chat guides plus shared features, and omit request. This is a closed source selection in _files, not an overlay priority algorithm. Antigravity overrides only README source and adds a rule.
Neither current native metadata declares render_profiles. The supported profile mechanism rejects overlap with core token names; it is not a shared-guide override mechanism.

execution.reason: Assignment permits fixture specification only; final verification belongs to exact frozen integration candidate.

native-dispatch.fact: Content profiles dispatch before native options; native Claude rejects Windows; Codex Windows replaces the launcher copy source/output.

native-render.fact: Templates resolve beneath host_source; manifest, hooks and shared_templates render before method templates.

native-procedure.fact: Canonical locale-specific procedures and catalogs are assembled from the sibling reasoning-content projection; locale fallback is rejected.

native-copy.fact: Command templates render, then copy_files runs in metadata order, then response policy and selected raw bundle are serialized.

copy-implementation.fact: File copies write source bytes to destination; directory copies recurse over source descendants.

native-runtime.fact: Only the selected runtime target is copied if present; embedded legacy bundles are replaced; Windows decision guides receive a final launcher spelling rewrite.

native-manifest.fact: File hashes are calculated after copies and platform rewrites; release-manifest.json is written after the payload inventory.

content-inputs.fact: Content profiles load both compiled bundles and response policy; fixed metadata must equal LAYOUTS and the closed delivery contract.

content-static-files.fact: Both content profiles use claude-chat controller/notices and decision guides, host-specific README, shared reader and features; request.json is absent.

content-procedure-rule.fact: Both content profiles assemble canonical procedures/catalogs; only Antigravity adds its standing rule.

content-manifest.fact: Source and payload inventories are authored into the content manifest; manifest itself is added after the files inventory.

content-closure.fact: Existing verifier enforces exact closed members, hashes, regular non-executable content, canonical pair identities and no hooks/runtime/bin/scripts.

content-output.fact: Default content output is build/generated/content-hosts/<host>; staging verifies ownership before replacement.

canonical-authoring.fact: Canonical authoring includes catalog, policies, ten locales, method.yaml, teacher questions, and per-locale procedures/cases.

canonical-compilation.fact: Compiled legacy bundle and compiled response policy are emitted from canonical sources.

projection-compilation.fact: Reasoning-content projections are serialized to the explicit projection output before legacy bundle compilation.

generation-recipe.fact: make generate owns schemas, bundles and all four package outputs; no S030 command invokes it.

existing-content-checker.fact: Existing checker covers determinism, portable ZIP modes, public skill count, catalog/procedure parity, reader/features byte parity and content layouts.

existing-rejection-checker.fact: Existing checker covers tamper rejection, modified-output preservation, executable/extra/script/link rejection, explicit-root CLI and unowned/source-overlapping output.

existing-locale-checker.fact: Existing checker rejects mislabeled locale fallback in all four generators.

existing-native-closure.fact: Existing release verifier compares payload hashes and inventory membership.

existing-native-surfaces.fact: Existing native surface checks consume configured methods, templates, public skills, commands and schema set.

mac-assembly.fact: Claude Mac runtime is copied from the built Codex Mac runtime; content-only profiles use their own builder; package roots are then archived.

windows-assembly.fact: Windows assembles Codex native and both portable content profiles; native Claude is not a Windows deliverable.

native-render-inputs.fact: Native render values load response policy, prefix strict-second-pass tokens with shared rigor activation guards and reject core-token overrides.

native: Compiled legacy bundle -> _common_values and _method_values -> host templates.
content/response-policy.yaml -> response-policy rendering -> locale template tokens and content/compiled-response-policy.json.
plugin-src/shared/rigor/activation.{locale}.md -> prefix of FRAGMENT_STRICT_SECOND_PASS token, where a template consumes it.
hooks_builder module -> HOOKS_JSON -> host hooks template.
content-only: Both compiled bundles -> common values and canonical procedure assembly.
content/response-policy.yaml -> response-policy locale tokens in the account controller.
No native rigor-activation prefix loop and no hooks builder in the content-only builder.
